text:
Grok Bot just autonomously made me $10,000

Yesterday I gave Grok Bot access to my business email. I get tons of business inquiries and sponsorship requests there

The problem is I HATE reading email

I told Grok to respond to and negotiate with any legit companies that email me

Within 4 hours Grok closed it's first deal. A deal it 100% negotiated on its own.

Did market research, found appropriate rates, and negotiated a final price

Paid for 33 months of itself

We live in the greatest time ever to be a solopreneur
